states: Private mock stack (backend :7761 built from this clone, Vite :5281 serving this branch on 32ef1d366d, PR 2598 plus its follow-up) with Playwright page.clock installed before load; data was not held, the attention detail and findings payloads keep fixed expiresAt, remind_at and snoozed_until

Patrol inbox, backend-seafile suppressed through the real form with the default 24 hours (read 'in 1d' when first suppressed): Reviewed and suppressed view, detail Lifecycle reads 'Returns to active attention in 21h.' with hover 'Suppressed until 7 Oct 17:33', and 'in 17h.' after the page clock moved 4 hours, at 1440 and 390

ops-prometheus marked reviewed through Mark reviewed, then suppressed for 24 hours from the handled view: Lifecycle reads 'Suppression ends in 23h. It stays reviewed.' (1d when first suppressed) with hover 'Suppressed until 7 Oct 19:19', and 'Suppression has ended.' after the page clock moved 25 hours, at 1440 and 390

Patrol activity, Finding options and history, Resolved: mail-gateway-us dismissed as Later through Finding options reads '(will fix later) · Reminding in 7d' with hover 'Reminder due 13 Oct 17:34. Pulse brings this finding back on its first reminder check after that.'; after the page clock moved 7 days it reads 'Reminder overdue' (hover 'Reminder was due 13 Oct 17:34. Pulse brings this finding back on its next reminder check.') and the 'Overdue commitments (1)' chip appears on the same tick and filters to that finding

Same list, dr-vault snoozed for 1 hour through POST /api/ai/patrol/snooze (Patrol rows hide the snooze buttons): reads 'snoozed, returns in 1h' with hover 'Snoozed until 6 Oct 21:17', 'in 20m' after 40 clock minutes, and after 70 minutes the next findings re-read shows it under Active with no snoozed row left in Resolved
No 'just now' on any future time at either viewport

Open Overdue rows staying mounted across clock ticks is covered by FindingsPanel.links.test.tsx (fails on the previous version of this change at the tick assertion); a live check cannot separate the tick from Patrol's 60-second findings re-read under a fast-forwarded clock

Same-session control (first pass of this change): with FindingsPanel.tsx and PatrolAttentionWorkbench.tsx swapped back to the PR 2598 base under the running Vite, the same rows read 'Returns to active attention just now.' (still after 4 clock hours), 'snoozed until just now' and 'Reminding just now'
interactions: Opened a decision in the Patrol inbox, filled the suppression reason and submitted Suppress temporarily (24 hours), then Reviewed and suppressed and opened the item
Opened a second decision, clicked Mark reviewed, opened it from Reviewed and suppressed and suppressed it for 24 hours
Opened Finding options on a finding, chose Dismiss: Later and Confirm Dismiss
Opened Activity, Finding options and history, switched the filter to Resolved, read hover text from title attributes, then clicked the Overdue commitments chip
Advanced the page clock 4 and 25 hours on the attention details, 40 then 30 minutes and 7 days on the findings list, at 1440x900 and 390x844
Read the same rows with the pre-change components as the control
